tools.name: js
tools.description:
Control native apps or browsers on the user’s computer by reading or operating UI. Prefer purpose-built skills, connectors, APIs, or CLIs when available.

On the first invocation of `cua_repl`, or after resetting it, execute exactly one of the API calls shown below, optionally assigning its result to a variable. Do not add other API calls, waits, or snapshots to that invocation.
The tool result will include documentation and, when creating or selecting a tab or selecting an app, its initial UI state. Selecting a browser does not open a tab. Read that result before continuing.
Use only APIs described in the tool instructions or returned documentation.

When you need an inventory of available apps, browsers, and tabs, get a snapshot of all enabled surfaces. Otherwise, use the relevant entry point below:

```javascript
await cua.getState();
```

Browser APIs are disabled.

If the user specifies an app to use, get the app by name, bundle ID, or path:

```javascript
let app = await cua.getApp("Example App");
```

To add other content to the tool result, use `nodeRepl.write(value)` for text or other values and `await nodeRepl.emitImage(image)` for images. The APIs listed above already display their documentation or UI state; do not wrap their results in `write` or `emitImage`.

If your context begins with a summary of an existing computer use task, call `await cua.rewriteDocumentation()` before continuing the computer use task to ensure you have a complete view of the necessary documentation.

code.description: JavaScript to execute using the initialized cua_repl runtime.

timeout_ms.description: Optional execution timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000 (30 seconds) when omitted.

title.description: Short user-facing description of what the code does.

tools.name: js_reset
tools.description: Reset the persistent cua_repl JavaScript session. All JavaScript bindings are discarded. The next cua_repl.js call initializes a fresh runtime for the enabled surfaces. This does not close browser tabs or native apps, or erase their state.

tools.name: turn_ended
tools.description: Notify trusted libraries that a Codex turn ended. Repeated notifications for the same session and turn are ignored.

documentation:
## Computer Use (Linux desktop)

Operate native apps and browsers on the workspace desktop with `cua_repl` (JavaScript with top-level await). Prefer purpose-built tools, APIs or CLIs when they can do the job, and use `cua_repl` rather than xdotool or other input tools for UI work. Variables, functions and app bindings persist across calls and turns of this chat.

### Start
```js
const app = await cua.getApp("Chrome");  // app name or window title text; launches an installed app if no window is open
// also: cua.getApp({ title: /Invoice/ }), cua.getApp({ windowId }) from cua.listWindows(), cua.getApp({ app, title })
```
`getApp` prints the window's accessibility tree once (`{ emit: false }` skips it). Dialogs are separate windows: `await cua.waitForWindow({ title: /Open/ })`, `cua.listWindows()`, `cua.listApps()`.

### Targets
Every action takes a target:
- A query (recommended): `{ role: "button", name: "Save" }`, `{ name: "Email" }`, `{ role: "radio", context: "Violence › None" }`, `"Upload"` (text of a tree line) or `/regex/`. Keys: `role`, `name`, `value`, `text` (name, value, description or context), `context`, `description`, `states` (`["checked"]`, `["!disabled"]`), `within` (a target whose subtree is searched), `index` (0-based match). Roles accept common names: button, textbox, checkbox, radio, combobox, option, link, menuitem, tab, dialog, table, cell, row, heading, image, slider. Strings match case-insensitively as substrings; an exact name wins among several matches, and actions prefer operable controls over their labels. A query is resolved when the action runs and waits up to 5 s (`timeoutMs`) for the element.
- An element ID from the tree, e.g. `42`. IDs stay the same while the element exists.
- `[x, y]` in the latest screenshot of this app (window pixels before any screenshot).

### Observe
```js
await app.getAXState();                    // after the first full tree only changes are printed (+ added, ~ changed, - removed)
await app.getAXState({ disableDiffing: true, root: { role: "dialog" } }); // everything, or one subtree
await app.find({ role: "textbox" });       // prints and returns only matches: [{ id, role, name, value, states, context, line }]
await app.waitFor("Saved", { timeoutMs: 10000 });         // waits until something matches; returns it
await app.waitFor({ text: "Processing" }, { gone: true }); // waits until it disappeared
await app.getScreenshot({ maxDimension: 1000, region: { role: "dialog" } }); // smaller images cost fewer tokens
await app.getAXStateAndScreenshot();
```
Tree lines read `id role (states) name, Value: …, Description: …, Context: …, Secondary Actions: …`. `Context` describes an unlabeled control by its row/column header or neighboring label, e.g. `radio button (unchecked) Context: Cartoon violence › None`. Hidden widgets are omitted. After input, observations wait until the app stops changing; use `waitFor` for slower loading. Return values are always complete: pass `{ emit: false }` and filter in code instead of printing large trees.

### Act
```js
await app.setValue(target, "1.0.0");  // replaces a field's text; also picks a combo box/list option by text,
await app.setValue(target, true);     // sets a checkbox, radio button or switch, and a slider/spin value (number);
                                      // verifies the result and returns { value } or { checked }
await app.click(target, { clickCount: 2, mouseButton: "right", key: "shift", durationMs: 500 });
await app.typeText("text", target);   // inserts at the caret of target (or the focused element); Unicode and multi-line
await app.typeCharacters("20");       // real key presses into the focused element, for fields that reject pasting
await app.pressKey("ctrl+a", { repeat: 1 });  // xdotool key names: "Return", "Tab", "Escape", "ctrl+shift+t"
await app.focus(target); await app.selectText(target, "word", { prefix, suffix, selectionType: "text" });
await app.scroll(target, "down", { pixels: 600 }); await app.scrollIntoView(target);
await app.drag(fromTarget, toTarget);
await app.performSecondaryAction(target, "expand"); // only actions listed in the tree
await app.getBounds(target);          // { x, y, width, height } in screenshot coordinates
await app.activate();                 // raise and focus the window; input normally works without it
```
`typeText` inserts; use `setValue` to replace existing text.

### Files
```js
await app.chooseFiles(["/workspace/shots/1.png", "/workspace/shots/2.png"], { trigger: { role: "button", name: "Upload" } });
await app.dropFiles(["/workspace/report.pdf"], { name: "Drop files here" });
const text = await nodeRepl.readFile("/workspace/texts/description.txt"); // { encoding: null } returns bytes
```
`chooseFiles` clicks the trigger (or uses an already open dialog), selects the files in the native file dialog (GTK, desktop portal or Qt) and confirms it; the files may come from different folders. `dropFiles` drops files from outside onto a drop zone, like a file manager.

### Output
`getApp`, `getAXState`, `find`, `waitFor`, screenshots and inventories print their own results; do not print them again. Use `nodeRepl.write(value)` and `await nodeRepl.emitImage(bytes)` for your own output; `console.log` works too.

### Workflow
- Batch deterministic actions and one observation in a single call. Prefer queries and `setValue`; verify with `find`/`waitFor` (a confirmation message, a field value, a counter) rather than screenshots.
- After navigating or submitting, wait for something only the new page has (its heading, a result text): the old page stays readable until the new one has loaded. `find` does not wait; `waitFor` and action queries do.
- Calls time out after 30 s by default; pass `timeout_ms` for long work.
- Use screenshots and coordinates only where the tree lacks an element (custom canvases). A tree with `Accessibility source: x11` has no actionable elements.
- A failed call stops at the failing statement; earlier statements already ran. A syntax error runs nothing.
- Persist until the requested result is visibly confirmed; otherwise report the concrete blocker.
